component.name: Harmony Remote
component.summary: Control Logitech Harmony hubs from the system tray

description.p: A tray remote for Logitech Harmony hubs that talks to the hub directly on your local network. There's no Logitech account or cloud involved, so it doesn't depend on Logitech's servers.
Click the tray icon to start an activity, change the volume, steer the menus or turn everything off. Keys repeat while held, just like the physical remote.
This is an independent project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Logitech.
First local build: tray icon and popup remote, activities, volume, d-pad, playback and every hub key.
